description: Fetch, preview and apply OpenCode Go models to Codex safely, sync Codex's model catalog, and bridge Chat Completions or Anthropic Messages through a loopback proxy.
command.syncModelCatalog: Sync OpenCode Go Models to Codex
command.openSettings: Open OpenCode Go for Codex Settings
walkthrough.title: Get started with OpenCode Go for Codex
walkthrough.description: Set your OpenCode Go API key, then pick a model for Codex.
walkthrough.setApiKey.title: Set your OpenCode Go API key
walkthrough.setApiKey.description: Subscribe to OpenCode Go, copy your API key, and store it here.
walkthrough.selectModel.title: Select a model for Codex
walkthrough.selectModel.description: Pick a model from the live list. Responses models work directly; other protocols use the loopback proxy. The extension writes Codex config.toml for you (with a backup).
config.title: OpenCode Go for Codex
config.apiKeyEnvVar.desc: Name of the environment variable written to the provider's `env_key` field. Codex reads this variable for authentication.
config.codexHome.desc: Directory containing Codex's `config.toml`. Leave empty to use the `CODEX_HOME` environment variable, or `~/.codex`.
config.codexExecutable.desc: Path to the Codex executable used to build Codex's model catalog (`codex debug models`) and to check the config still loads. Leave empty to auto-detect the Codex CLI or the binary bundled with the Codex VS Code extension.
config.maxBackups.desc: Maximum number of timestamped `config.toml.bak-*` backups to keep.
config.showUnsupportedModels.desc: Show models that are unavailable in the current mode (Chat Completions or Anthropic Messages while the local proxy is off).
config.showDeprecatedModels.desc: Show models marked as deprecated in the models.dev catalog.
config.modelsDevMirrorUrl.desc: Fallback mirror for the models.dev catalog (tried when models.dev is unreachable). Accepts the full catalog URL, or a base URL ending with `/`. Leave empty to disable.
config.modelsDevMirrorToken.desc: Optional token sent as the `x-mirror-token` header when fetching the catalog mirror.
config.modelsDevUpdateInterval.desc: How often (ms) the models.dev catalog and the live model list are refreshed. Minimum 30000.
config.showUsage.desc: Show OpenCode Go plan usage in the combined status bar item. The item also shows the local proxy state and stays visible while the proxy is on.
config.usageRefreshInterval.desc: How often (minutes) the OpenCode Go plan usage is refreshed, clamped to 1-60.
config.usageDisplayWindow.desc: Which quota window the usage status bar item shows in its text.
config.usageWarningThreshold.desc: Usage percentage at which the status bar item turns yellow. The worst of the three windows decides.
config.usageErrorThreshold.desc: Usage percentage at which the status bar item turns red. The worst of the three windows decides.
config.proxyEnabled.desc: Run the loopback bridge for native Responses repair plus Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages translation, and keep the OpenCode Go provider pointed at it. Disabling it restores the direct endpoint but may break thinking models that require reasoning_text replay.
config.proxyPort.desc: Port for the loopback OpenCode Go proxy (1024-65535).
